unit.name: Monkey D. Luffy
unit.summary: A bold elastic striker who fires stretched punches, marks enemies with Haki pressure, and unlocks a manual Gear Smash for bounded burst control.

actions.name: Gum-Gum Pistol
actions.summary: Fires a stretched punch at the first eligible enemy in range.

actions.name: Conqueror's Haki
actions.summary: When enabled, automatically pressures nearby enemies with a stunning Haki aura.

actions.name: Gear Smash
actions.summary: A manual enlarged strike that damages several enemies in the chosen area.

abilities.name: Gear Smash
abilities.summary: Manually activates Gear Smash for a powerful multi-target blow with a 16-second recovery.

paths.name: Elastic Reach
paths.summary: Improves repeated ranged coverage and reach, but provides no crowd control or active burst.

paths.name: Haki Command
paths.summary: Adds marking, stun, and reveal pressure, but contributes less direct damage.

paths.name: Gear Burst
paths.summary: Unlocks a powerful manual multi-target strike, but its value is gated by ability recovery.

nodes.name: Twin Punch
nodes.summary: Gum-Gum Pistol fires two projectiles per cycle.

nodes.name: Passing Fist
nodes.summary: Each Gum-Gum Pistol projectile can hit one additional target.

nodes.name: Wide Release
nodes.summary: Gum-Gum Pistol gains a second emitter for broader firing angles.

nodes.name: Observation Mark
nodes.summary: Gum-Gum Pistol hits apply Haki Mark for 5 seconds.

nodes.name: Conqueror's Pressure
nodes.summary: Unlocks the automatic Conqueror's Haki aura.

nodes.name: Overwhelming Presence
nodes.summary: Conqueror's Haki stun duration becomes 1.6 seconds.

nodes.name: Unseen Foe
nodes.summary: Conqueror's Haki also reveals affected enemies for 4 seconds.

nodes.name: Gear Smash
nodes.summary: Unlocks the Gear Smash active ability and its manual action.

nodes.name: Crushing Radius
nodes.summary: Gear Smash can affect two additional enemies.

nodes.name: Rubber Rebound
nodes.summary: Gear Smash displaces each affected enemy by 6 world units.

visuals.description: A readable silhouette of Monkey D. Luffy wearing his recognizable straw hat, with elastic attack poses and clear Haki effects.

animations.description: Luffy stretches and slingshots one or more punches toward the selected enemy.
A brief dark-red and black pressure pulse radiates from Luffy when Conqueror's Haki activates.
Luffy enlarges and drives a heavy compressed strike into the selected area.

audio.description: A sharp elastic snap followed by a heavy punch impact.
A low, forceful pressure burst for Conqueror's Haki.
A deep impact cue with a short compressed-air release.

plan.identity: Monkey D. Luffy — One Piece manga continuity, adapted as a placed damage/control/burst unit centered on elastic ranged punches, Haki pressure, and a bounded Gear burst.

sourceAnchors.gameplayConnection: Straw Hat identity, cheerful aggression, and loyal captaincy support a bold frontline combat unit rather than a passive economy unit.
The rubber-like Devil Fruit, voluntary stretching, and Gum-Gum Pistol become Luffy's default ranged projectile attack.
Gear 3's high-damage attacks and Luffy's Haki abilities support separate burst and control progression axes.

alternatives.organizingPrinciple: Combat decision axes: elastic reach, Haki control, and Gear burst.

paths.name: Elastic Reach
paths.tradeoff: Improves repeated ranged coverage and reach, but provides no crowd control or active burst.

paths.name: Haki Command
paths.tradeoff: Adds marking, stun, and reveal pressure, but contributes less direct damage.

paths.name: Gear Burst
paths.tradeoff: Unlocks a powerful manual area strike, but its value is gated by the ability cooldown.

alternatives.organizingPrinciple: Encounter roles: captain economy, predictive Haki, and encounter-selected Gear forms.

paths.name: Captain's Rally
paths.tradeoff: Emphasizes ally-facing or economy effects, but the contract supplies no generic ally stat modifiers and the combat identity becomes weaker.

paths.name: Observation Focus
paths.tradeoff: Builds a precision-and-reveal loop, but depends more heavily on target conditions and supplies less elastic spectacle.

paths.name: Gear Forms
paths.tradeoff: Supports encounter configurations for Gear progression, but forms are external encounter selections rather than runtime transformations.

plan.selectionReason: Alternative a preserves the strongest supplied combat identity—stretching ranged punches, Haki pressure, and Gear power—while giving each path an independent decision axis. Alternative b is feasible only with more economy, ally, and form adaptation, weakening the focused combat loop.

adaptations.contractReason: Projectile delivery directly supports ranged punches; exact named-attack animation and physics are presentation requirements rather than new mechanics.

adaptations.gameTreatment: Gear 3 is represented by the manual Gear Smash active ability, an area burst with damage and forced movement. The shrinking drawback is not modeled.

adaptations.contractReason: Declared status, reveal, aura, and control effects provide a small supported abstraction; Future Sight, Haki coating, and exact immunity rules are omitted.

adaptations.gameTreatment: No runtime awakening or Gear 5 transformation is included.

adaptations.sourceTrait: Luffy has electrical and blunt-force resistances, while sharp weapons, water, and Sea-Prism Stone remain weaknesses.
adaptations.gameTreatment: No resistance, immunity, swimming, or Sea-Prism interaction is defined.
adaptations.contractReason: Generic defensive stat modifiers and the supplied context needed for these interactions are unavailable in the default unit contract.

adaptations.contractReason: The source gives no precise costs or durations, and adding a resource would not create a necessary player decision for this focused loop.

implementation.loop: Place one Luffy unit for 650 credits. His default luffy-pistol fires one 65-speed projectile every 1.1 seconds at the first eligible enemy within 28 world units for 30 physical damage. Elastic Reach increases coverage and reach; Haki Command marks enemies and periodically controls nearby targets; Gear Burst unlocks one manual 16-second Gear Smash area attack
implementation.limitsCheck: The design uses one placement, a medium-band 650-credit cost, three paths with five cumulative tiers each, and a maximum selection of seven nodes with one primary path through tier 5 and at most one crosspath through tier 2. It has three prominent mechanics: projectile damage, Haki status/control, and one active ability. No resources, summons, forms, passive reactions, healing, shields, generic stat modifiers, or runtime transformations are used. All listed ranges remain between 18 and 46 world units; attack intervals and cooldowns remain within 0.15 to 30 seconds; status and effect durations,

knowledge.subject: Monkey D. Luffy

identity.name: Monkey D. Luffy
identity.continuity: One Piece manga continuity (original published continuity)
identity.explanation: The supplied page is specifically about Monkey D. Luffy from Eiichiro Oda's One Piece manga. The requested continuity is explicitly supported by the page; facts from the anime, live-action adaptation, games, and crossover appearances are excluded from this record.

claims.text: Monkey D. Luffy is the main protagonist of the One Piece manga, created by Eiichiro Oda, and first appears in chapter 1, “Romance Dawn.”
He is also known as “Straw Hat” Luffy and is the captain of the Straw Hat Crew.
Luffy is a pirate pursuing the dream of finding the One Piece and becoming King of the Pirates, a goal influenced by his idol and mentor Red-Haired Shanks.

His listed affiliations include the Straw Hat Grand Fleet, of which he is the de facto commodore; the Worst Generation; the Four Emperors; and the former Ninja-Pirate-Mink-Samurai Alliance, which he co-led.
Luffy is generally cheerful, carefree, optimistic, good-hearted, ambitious, and extremely hungry, but becomes serious or aggressive in fights and when his friends are harmed.
He is a loyal captain who repeatedly risks his life for his crew and other people he chooses to protect, often acting according to what he believes is right despite the consequences.
His family and sworn-family relationships include Monkey D. Dragon as his father, Monkey D. Garp as his grandfather, and Portgas D. Ace and Sabo as sworn brothers.
Luffy's principal crew members include Roronoa Zoro, Nami, Usopp, Sanji, Tony Tony Chopper, Nico Robin, Franky, Brook, and Jimbei.
Luffy ate a Devil Fruit whose concealed true name is the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika; it was widely known as the Gum-Gum Fruit because of World Government propaganda.

The Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika is described as a Mythical Zoan-type Devil Fruit. Its ordinary effect gives Luffy a rubber-like body, while its awakening grants increased strength and freedom associated with Nika.
The fruit lets Luffy stretch his body at will and use elasticity to accelerate part or all of his body for punches, kicks, headbutts, and other attacks.
His signature Gum-Gum Pistol is a ranged punch in which he stretches and slingshots his arm toward an opponent.
Luffy's rubber attributes make him immune to electric attacks and resistant to most blunt-force attacks.
Sharp objects and weapons, including swords and spears, remain effective against Luffy and are a stated weakness of his rubber-like body.
Like other Devil Fruit users, Luffy cannot swim. Submersion in water or contact with Sea-Prism Stone causes him to lose his strength and prevents him from moving independently.
Apart from his Devil Fruit, Luffy possesses immense strength, durability, speed, reflexes, agility, endurance, and stamina.
After observing CP9's Shave technique, Luffy developed Gear 2, using his body as a pump to circulate blood at high speed and temporarily increase his strength and speed.
Gear 2 places substantial strain on Luffy's body, consumes energy rapidly, and is stated to be capable of shortening his lifespan if maintained for too long.
Gear 3 involves blowing air into his thumb bone and moving that air through his other bones to enlarge body parts, enabling high-damage attacks.
Gear 3 originally caused Luffy to shrink afterward. After the two-year time skip, he gained better control of Gears 2 and 3 and was no longer affected by their stated drawbacks.
Gear 4 inflates Luffy's muscles with air, enlarges most of his body except his legs, and coats his limbs with Armament Haki.

Gear 4 uses compression rather than simple extension: Luffy compresses and releases his limbs to produce extremely powerful blows. The force of its kicks can propel him through the air in a manner comparable to CP9's Moon Walk.
Luffy can use Gear 2 and Gear 3 simultaneously, and the page describes the Gears as techniques through which he transforms or modifies his body to grow stronger over the course of the story.

The awakening of the Human-Human Fruit, Model: Nika allows Luffy's rubber-like body to gain increased strength and freedom, including the ability to turn the environment and other living beings into rubber.
Gear 5 is Luffy's awakened transformation. In this state his hair and clothes turn white, and he can fight in forms permitted by his awakened freedom and imagination.
The page describes Gear 5's awakening as being triggered after Luffy suffered an apparently fatal blow from Kaidou, with the thrill of the confrontation preceding the transformation.
The awakened fruit's freedom is described as limited only by the user's imagination, and Nika is associated with the “embodiment of freedom” and bringing joy to people around the user.
The World Government sought the fruit for more than 800 years, renamed it to erase its original name from history, and reclassified it as a Paramecia to conceal its true nature.
Luffy can use all three types of Haki: Armament Haki, Observation Haki, and Conqueror's Haki.
Armament Haki functions as an armor-like force that increases defense and attack power, can negate some Devil Fruit defenses, and enables physical contact with otherwise protected targets.
Observation Haki acts as a sixth sense that detects presences and reads an opponent's movements.
Conqueror's Haki can render weak-willed people or animals near Luffy unconscious.
During his fight with Charlotte Katakuri, Luffy developed an advanced application of Observation Haki called Future Sight, allowing him to see several seconds into the future.
While imprisoned in Udon, Luffy learned an advanced Armament Haki application called Emission, which projects a short blast of Haki at a distance.
He also learned Internal Destruction, an advanced Armament Haki application that can penetrate a target or object and destroy it from within.
During his battle with Kaidou on Onigashima, Luffy unlocked an advanced Conqueror's Haki application that coats his body and further enhances his attacks.
After his encounter with Magellan, Luffy developed immunity to poison, although the page states that strong poison can still affect him, albeit very slowly.

Luffy's characteristic reach includes defeating major opponents such as Buggy, Don Krieg, Arlong, Crocodile, Enel, Doflamingo, Charlotte Katakuri, and Kaidou, while repeatedly liberating or protecting communities and allies.
He led the Straw Hats in declaring war on the World Government to retrieve Nico Robin from Enies Lobby, demonstrating that his captaincy extends to direct conflict with global powers.
After the two-year training period, Luffy and his crew became stronger so that they would be less likely to lose crew members while pursuing the One Piece.
Following the Wano events, Luffy was recognized as one of the Four Emperors, and the Straw Hat Grand Fleet was described as containing more than 5,600 pirates.
The page lists Luffy's current bounty as 3,000,000,000, following earlier bounties of 30,000,000, 100,000,000, 300,000,000, 400,000,000, 500,000,000, and 1,500,000,000.
The page presents Luffy's bounty as a measure of the threat and notoriety he poses to the World Government within the One Piece world.

gaps: Only one supplied source is available, and it is a secondary reference page rather than direct manga excerpts; no separate primary-source verification was supplied.

The source excerpt mixes manga-continuity facts with anime, live-action, video-game, crossover, reception, and real-world material. Those adaptation and extraneous details were excluded from the selected record.
The excerpt does not provide a complete catalog of Luffy's named attacks, Gear 4 variants, Gear 5 applications, or all Haki techniques.
Exact duration, recovery requirements, energy costs, and additional weaknesses of Gear 4 and Gear 5 are not specified in the supplied evidence.
The excerpt gives no precise range, reliability conditions, or countermeasures for Future Sight, Emission, Internal Destruction, or Conqueror's Haki coating.
The scope of Luffy's poison immunity is only partially described: strong poison can affect him slowly, but the evidence does not define the full range of toxins or concentrations involved.
The source provides broad progression milestones but does not specify every training prerequisite or the exact chronology of each technique's first use.
The source's description of current status is limited to the events and information included in the excerpt; later manga developments are not established here.
